business_problem: Ooredoo Qatar sought to optimize 5G network performance and subscriber experience while reducing operating costs.
solution_summary: Ericsson and Ooredoo Qatar deployed Ericsson Cognitive Software on Microsoft cloud in Qatar to optimize the 5G Radio Access Network (RAN). The solution uses digital twin technology and deep reinforcement learning to analyze the RAN, identify specific network performance issues, and proactively provide mobile network optimization recommendations intended to improve subscriber connectivity while reducing operating costs. Ericsson Performance Optimizers is the named optimization suite; it is part of the Cognitive Software pack in Ericsson Operations Engine. Microsoft cloud is the stated hosting environment, with Microsoft's hyperscale datacenter in Qatar named as the local cloud context. The release does not specify how RAN data is ingested, what processing or storage services are used, how recommendations are delivered to operator systems, or whether remediation is automated; no such pipeline or integration is inferred here.
